title: Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry

metadata.completion_statement: This one Decree is fully translated into English, including Articles 1 through 23, all inserted and deleted provisions, and every supplied addendum from Presidential Decree No. 21847 through No. 36433, including consequential amendments and omission notices. Separate attached tables and forms are excluded as instructed. The translation is MACHINE_TRANSLATION / UNREVIEWED.
